question: In which year was the Swaran Singh Committee set up by the Indira Gandhi Government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swaran Singh Committee** was set up in **1976** by the **Indira Gandhi Government**.
 
• The primary objective of the Swaran Singh Committee was to make recommendations for the incorporation of **Fundamental Duties** into the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• Based on the committee's recommendations, the **42nd Amendment Act** was enacted in **1976**, which introduced the **Fundamental Duties** in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The committee was headed by **Sardar Swaran Singh**, who was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and a former Union Minister.
 
• The inclusion of Fundamental Duties aimed to remind citizens of their responsibilities towards the nation and promote a sense of discipline and commitment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sardar Swaran Singh**__

 __
 
• **Sardar Swaran Singh** was a prominent Indian politician and a senior leader of the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• He served as the **Union Minister** in various capacities, including the portfolios of **Defence, External Affairs, and Railways**.
 
• He was instrumental in shaping India's foreign policy during his tenure as the **Minister of External Affairs**.
 
 
 
• **42nd Amendment Act**__
 
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act** of **1976** is also known as the **"Mini-Constitution"** due to its comprehensive nature.
 
• It brought significant changes to the Constitution, including the addition of the **Fundamental Duties** and the **Directive Principles of State Policy**.
 
• The amendment also aimed to reduce the power of the judiciary and strengthen the executive.
